appDescription: Car care agent that watches vehicle warnings and maintenance and helps the driver act on them with the driver's approval.

function.name: CHECK_CAR_CARE_STATUS
function.description: Tells the driver the current car care status, including active warnings, remaining range, and the next maintenance due.

function.name: RECORD_MAINTENANCE
function.description: Starts recording a maintenance service the driver just received, which the driver confirms on screen before it is saved.

items.description: Maintenance items the driver mentioned, such as engine oil or oil filter.
